Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.3:

- Version & EoS Summary now auto-populates DSPM and Data Classification (FDC) components from their Product Lifecycle pages. When you select DSPM or Classification in Product Scope, the DSPM Server/Agent and Classification Server/Agent rows pull their latest version, GA date and EoSale/EoM/EoSupport straight from the matching Product Lifecycle entry.
- If a solution has no matching lifecycle entry, every column remains fully editable via the row's Edit (override) control, so versions can always be filled in manually.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
